_doc: Army-level casualty figures of the Gettysburg campaign as the project holds them: the PDF B.1 table (secondary sources: Wikipedia, Stone Sentinels, Busey and Martin as cited there, the Civil War Medicine museum) and the OR27 figures confirmed by the claim check (library/or27_claim_checks.json, items n and s). They are the ONLY inputs to the fate split and to the total-loss range of a unit; no regimental casualty number is in this file or anywhere in the layer. Every number is checked against BIBLE/plan-clean.txt or the claim check by tests/casualties.test.mjs.
